name: reply_all
description:
Reply to all recipients of an Outlook email. The Outlook server automatically determines
the correct To/CC recipients from the original message -- you do NOT need to specify recipients.

IMPORTANT: This sends to ALL original recipients (sender + all To + all CC).

For replying to ONLY the sender (or a specific subset of people), do NOT use this tool.
Instead use outlook_send_message with reply_to_message_id and conversation_id, specifying
only the recipients you want in the to field.

message_id.description: Message ID to reply to (from outlook_search or outlook_get_message)

body_html.description: Optional HTML body for rich formatting
